title: Wardrobe gender-tags
description: Suggested gender tags. They describe the garment’s cut or where it was sold, never the wearer; people can add their own.

id.description: Stable id: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Saved wardrobes refer to it, so it is never renamed or reused once shipped.

emoji.description: Optional emoji shown before the name wherever the tag appears (filter chips, the item form, shelf headings), as a quick visual cue. Tags people add themselves have none.
